title: Contain an agent failure before it becomes a side effect
description: Inject a failure, then change authority and recovery controls. The trace shows whether the action is blocked, retried once, duplicated, or escalated for review.

permissions.label: Read only
permissions.detail: The run can inspect approved data but cannot mutate external state.

permissions.label: Scoped write
permissions.detail: The run can perform one task-specific mutation within tenant and amount limits.

permissions.label: Privileged access
permissions.detail: The run can perform administrative or broadly destructive actions.

policies.label: Stop and review
policies.detail: Preserve evidence and require a new authorized decision.

policies.label: Bounded retry
policies.detail: Retry once only when the operation proves retry safety.

policies.label: Continue anyway
policies.detail: Demonstrates the risk of treating an error or hostile instruction as permission.

scenarios.label: Read-only search times out
scenarios.brief: The search tool returns no result before its deadline.
scenarios.safeAction: Retry once with the same bounded query, then return a typed unavailable result.
scenarios.unsafeOutcome: An unbounded loop keeps spending time and tokens without creating new evidence.

scenarios.label: Refund call times out after submission
scenarios.brief: The payment API accepted a mutation, but the response was lost.
scenarios.safeAction: Read the payment state by idempotency key before deciding whether any retry is needed.
scenarios.unsafeOutcome: A blind retry can issue the refund twice.

scenarios.label: Retrieved page requests a secret
scenarios.brief: Untrusted search content tells the agent to reveal credentials and ignore its task.
scenarios.safeAction: Treat the text as evidence, deny the authority change, and record the injection signal.
scenarios.unsafeOutcome: Continuing with broad authority can expose secrets or trigger unrelated tools.

scenarios.label: Planner proposes an admin deletion
scenarios.brief: A cleanup plan expands from deleting one generated artifact to deleting a shared workspace.
scenarios.safeAction: Deny the expanded scope and require a separately reviewed, path-bounded operation.
scenarios.unsafeOutcome: Over-broad credentials turn a planning error into irreversible data loss.
